about: Labels from a domain expert (the HR policy owner) for every scored claim. Use these to check the judge, not to replace it.

labels.claim: You can carry over up to 5 days of unused PTO into the new year.
Anything above 5 days is forfeited on January 1.
Employees in California keep their full balance.
The meal limit during business travel is $60 per day.
You need an itemized receipt for any meal over $15.
Laptops are refreshed every three years.
Engineers can ask for a refresh after two years if their machine no longer meets build requirements.
You can work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.
Working abroad for a month is allowed as long as your manager approves.
labels.note: rem-1 covers days per week, not working abroad. rem-2 (not retrieved) requires notifying HR after 14 days abroad.

labels.claim: Report it to the IT service desk within 24 hours.
IT will remotely wipe the device for you.
labels.note: it-2 says the device can be wiped, not that IT will do it for you. The answer turns a capability into a promise.

labels.claim: Corporate cards are issued to employees who travel more than four times per year.
You can request one from the finance team.
Cards come with a $5,000 monthly limit.
Requests for more than 5 consecutive working days need manager approval at least two weeks in advance.
